title: Grocery Giant Ahold Delhaize Estimates Financial Toll of October Cyberattack
description: In October 2026, Ahold Delhaize, a major Dutch-Belgian grocery retailer, suffered a cyberattack that disrupted operations in the US and Benelux regions. The incident led to significant financial impacts, including an estimated reduction of €200 million to €250 million in fourth-quarter net sales and a €75 million to €100 million hit to operating income. The company temporarily disconnected some systems to contain the attack, affecting online capabilities and supply-chain operations. No evidence of data theft was reported at the time. The attack caused the company to lower its 2026 financial outlook. The specific attack type has not been disclosed.
